scientific_status: post-inspection causal retrospective mechanism development for a prospective logging contract; not validation
purpose: Determine whether causally observed parent-loop path events explain or improve the early-gain/late-loss payoff split inside the two frozen loop orientations without tuning admission conditions or price thresholds.

population.population_source: exact V2 signal-level artifact after the first 60 completed provider sessions were excluded

causal_clock.state_label_availability: A transition is observable only after the first completed 5-minute bar assigned to the new state closes.
causal_clock.hypothetical_exit_price: The next provider bar open after event detection.
causal_clock.event_before_entry: Recorded as a pre-entry path status but never treated as a post-entry exit event.
causal_clock.event_on_entry_bar: Detected only after that bar closes and may exit only at the following provider open.
causal_clock.latest_actionable_event: The detection bar must have a following provider open at or before the frozen anchor+24 close bar.
causal_clock.fallback: If the specified event is absent, pre-entry, or not actionable before the frozen close, retain the frozen anchor+24 close.
forbidden_event_inputs: future state beyond the detection bar
future run duration or run end

outcome_only_path_topology.window: anchor state-run start through the frozen anchor+24 state position, inclusive

categories.no_transition: No state transition occurs by the frozen close.
categories.expected_leg_partial: The first transition is anchor_state->expected_alternate_state and no second transition occurs by the frozen close.
categories.exact_parent_completion: The first two transitions are anchor_state->expected_alternate_state->anchor_state; later transitions do not change the first-completion label.
categories.incompatible_first_transition: The first transition is not to the expected alternate state.
categories.expected_leg_then_diversion: The first transition reaches the expected alternate state but the second transition is not back to the anchor state.

outcome_only_path_topology.interpretation: Descriptive oracle classification of the completed 24-bar path; only the first causally observed terminal event may drive a hypothetical exit.

pre_entry_path_status.clock: Uses only transition bars strictly before the entry bar.

causal_event_definitions.first_post_entry_transition: First transition bar whose state position is at or after the entry state position.
causal_event_definitions.exact_completion: First return to anchor_state after the immediately preceding expected alternate leg, provided the anchor route had not already completed or invalidated before entry.
causal_event_definitions.route_invalidation: First incompatible transition from anchor_state, or first diversion after the expected alternate leg, provided invalidation was not already known before entry.
causal_event_definitions.terminal_route_event: Whichever of exact_completion or route_invalidation is first; route construction makes them mutually exclusive before the first terminal event.

hypotheses.expected_benefit: Determine whether fixed-close winners, timing failures, and no-usable-move losses occupy different parent-state paths.
hypotheses.safety_or_validity_risk: The 24-bar topology is oracle-only and could be mistaken for an admission predictor.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Stop any admission-rule interpretation; topology may only motivate prospectively logged causal events.

hypotheses.expected_benefit: Test an untuned path-state exit that reacts to exact completion or route invalidation and may prevent favorable excursion from being surrendered.
hypotheses.safety_or_validity_risk: Detecting with the transition bar and exiting at that same bar would leak the completed-bar label.
hypotheses.validation_command: uv run python work/run_causal_loop_state_path_v1.py --out <new-output> && uv run python work/audit_causal_loop_state_path_v1.py --artifact <new-output>
hypotheses.stop_condition: Do not carry this path beyond prospective logging unless all four primary candidate-period paired endpoints clear support, positive effect, block interval, Holm, quarter, leave-one-stock-out, and absolute-cost gates on genuinely sealed data.

hypotheses.expected_benefit: Separate profit capture after exact parent completion from loss containment after route failure.
hypotheses.safety_or_validity_risk: Selecting whichever event looks best after results would create an unregistered exit family.
hypotheses.stop_condition: Treat completion-only and invalidation-only policies as secondary exploratory mechanisms with family-wise multiplicity control; do not choose one as a rule from opened periods.

hypotheses.expected_benefit: Distinguish information in the expected loop route from the generic effect of shortening exposure after any state change.
hypotheses.safety_or_validity_risk: A shorter holding period can masquerade as loop-path information.
hypotheses.stop_condition: If the terminal-route policy does not consistently beat the first-transition control, interpret any benefit as holding-time evidence rather than parent-loop evidence.

hypotheses.expected_benefit: Identify whether unresolved topology suggests parent-loop coarseness without using realised child or morph labels.
hypotheses.safety_or_validity_risk: Realised child or morph identity is an oracle label.
hypotheses.validation_command: independent leakage audit must confirm no child or morph outcome enters event or payoff logic
hypotheses.stop_condition: Do not test child or morph admission conditions unless a separate causal forecast is frozen first.

evaluation.primary_endpoints: paired mean net-return difference in each of four primary candidate-period cells

bootstrap.alternative: policy minus fixed is greater than zero

evaluation.primary_multiplicity: Holm adjustment across the four primary terminal-policy endpoints
evaluation.secondary_multiplicity: Separate Holm adjustment across the twelve completion-only, invalidation-only, and first-transition endpoints
primary_mechanism_gate: candidate support >= 50 in every candidate-period cell
actionable terminal-route events >= 30 in every candidate-period cell
paired mean difference > 0 in every candidate-period cell
95% session-block interval lower bound > 0 in every candidate-period cell
all four one-sided primary endpoints pass Holm at 0.05
at least three of four quarters have positive paired mean difference in every candidate-period cell
at least 16 of 20 leave-one-stock-out deletions have positive paired mean difference in every candidate-period cell
absolute primary-policy mean net return remains positive at 5 bps per side in every candidate-period cell
path_descriptives: fixed-close positive rate and mean net payoff
event coverage, detection bar, next-open payoff, and fallback rate
